_comment: R18-A2 / AT-529 — deterministic offline fixture for the Git content change-based ingestor (GitContentIngestor). The commit graph IS the change feed: 'head_sha' is the current position, 'head_tree' is the file content at HEAD (streamed as the resumable first load — AC1), and 'diffs' maps a since-SHA to the exact file set the commits between it and HEAD touched (the diff-driven incremental — AC2). Each diff records 'commit_count' so a test can verify commit-count vs files-processed (AC2). A file marked "binary": true is skipped-with-reason and never indexed (AC7, foundational). Content is short but real text so the substrate's code chunk policy has something to chunk. No secrets and no credentials live here — the connector never stores credentials in config.
